title: Error Constellation: contextual retry-waterfall + payload microdrill prototype
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Design a compact, scannable debugging surface — ‘Error Constellation’ — that surfaces correlated failed requests across a rollout, visualizes retry cascades as an interactive waterfall, and enables a microdrill into request payload diffs and KV-cache context without leaving the console. This aims to reduce time-to-root-cause for engineers on paging incidents and for PMs running post-rollout quality checks. The view should be accessible from the Rollouts detail page and from the Requests Explorer as a contextual panel.
user_stories: As an on-call engineer, I want to see all failed requests tied to a rollout bucket rendered as a retry waterfall so I can quickly spot where retries cluster and correlate with model variants or infra events.
As an SRE, I want to click a retry node and open an inline payload microdrill that shows token-level diffs and KV-cache snapshots so I can confirm whether input divergence triggered the failure.
As a PM, I want lightweight, exportable summaries from the constellation for post-mortems so we can quantify customer impact per rollout step.
As a designer, I want the prototype to demonstrate progressive disclosure (overview -> waterfall -> microdrill) to keep the main Console page uncluttered.
design_notes: Key constraints: must load quickly for large rollouts (10k+ requests) so upstream service should return pre-aggregated retry topology. Visual encoding: circle nodes for requests, size ~ token count, color by final status (red=failed, amber=degraded, green=success). Line thickness encodes retry count. Microdrill modal should show three lanes: raw payload, normalized payload diff (inline token highlights), and KV-cache snapshot timeline. Trade-offs: we avoid rendering full payloads inline by default (privacy + perf); users must click to reveal. For on-prem customers, payload reveal respects KMS and audit policies. Prototype demonstrates collapsed-state for high-noise rollouts and switchable grouping by client, region, or model-variant.
acceptance_criteria: Overview shows constellation for a selected rollout with top 50 correlated failure groups and basic metrics (count, p95 latency, error class).
Interactive retry waterfall opens with hover tooltips that show request id, retry index, timestamp, and model variant.
Payload microdrill reveals a token-diff view and a KV-cache snapshot for a selected retry node with a single click (respecting data access controls).
Prototype performs acceptably in user testing with 5 engineers on datasets of 2k requests (no perceived lag >400ms for transitions).
Export button generates a concise JSON summary of selected nodes for inclusion in incident reports.
Design handoff includes Figma tokens, accessible color palette (WCAG contrast), and component spec for node, edge, and microdrill modal.
PM sign-off confirming mappings to console telemetry and E2E query shape (pre-agg RSVP) is attached.
Security review notes included for payload reveal behavior and audit logging.
